scene_prompt: Create a 3D glossy modern fashion-show space with a central runway for outfit displays, surrounded by a dressing and outfit-creation area, plus a separate display area for posted outfit looks.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, specifically a dress-up social experience with no competitive scoring. The runway is for presentation rather than a judged game mode.

### Shape and preset
Use `stage-runway`, matching the Dress Up preset. This is a glossy fashion venue: a single central catwalk is the focal structure, with preparation and look-display spaces arranged around it.

### Config requirements
Use `vignette-photo` as visible geometry: create polished outfit-display backdrops and framed look-posting stations where avatars can present completed outfits. No invisible layout options are required.

### Layout components
Place a long raised runway on the central axis, ending in a broad pose platform at the front. Put a dense dressing and outfit-creation zone behind and along both sides of the runway, organized as mirrored vanity counters, mirrors, garment racks, styling booths, and seating bays. Set a separate posted-look gallery along one side or at the rear: a clean wall of illuminated display frames, pedestal mannequins, and small viewing alcoves, visually distinct from the active runway. Keep wide glossy floor aisles linking dressing, runway, and gallery without crossing the pose platform. The venue is an enclosed modern interior, bounded by dark polished walls and a high ceiling; use reflective black flooring, white architectural panels, chrome trim, soft pink-violet accent lighting, and runway spotlights. Frame the scene symmetrically from a slightly elevated front-corner view so the catwalk, preparation wings, and gallery all read at once.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the glossy fashion-show composition and its central visual hierarchy are authoritative, while the top-down plan can be projected from that image.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use a medium scale, driven by three distinct but closely connected venue zones. Theme: glossy modern fashion show, upscale studio lighting, polished editorial styling. Use `P0`; this is one enclosed venue on a single surface, with no overlapping floors or outside-to-inside transition.
